## What I do

- ⚙️ **Corporate automation & RPA**: from process analysis to production monitoring and troubleshooting
- 🔌 **REST API integrations**: reusable Python packages, OAuth 2.0, retries, fallbacks and duplicate prevention
- 📄 **AI document processing**: structured data extraction from varied layouts
- 🤖 **AI agents**: reusable agents for process discovery, documentation and development support

🎓 Systems Analysis and Development at IFRS (2024–2027)
